lines.speaker: 휴고
lines.text: It's been a while, greenhorn.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you been well?

lines.speaker: 휴고
lines.text: Same as ever.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What did you need me for?

lines.speaker: 휴고
lines.text: The Alliance of Light is making an official request for your help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Directly from the Alliance of Light?

lines.speaker: 휴고
lines.text: That's right. You know Iris's unstable condition is causing strange phenomena all over the world?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I know.

lines.speaker: 휴고
lines.text: Then this should be quick to explain.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't like to brag, but I've already dealt with two of them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The incidents in Coral City and the Amaloon Desert...

lines.speaker: 휴고
lines.text: Jiendia, Eastland... And this time, it seems to be the Mirgandia region of Freios. Have you been there? I hear there's a mercenary company...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I helped them out for a little while.

lines.speaker: 휴고
lines.text: Then you're just the person for this job. Go speak to the person in charge there and proceed from there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...The person in charge would be Parmila, I suppose?)

lines.speaker: 휴고
lines.text: Yuran told me you can handle things on your own.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can, but this is still very little information to go on.

lines.speaker: 휴고
lines.text: Sorry about that. We don't know enough yet. In any case, we'll take good care of Iris while she's in Lumen. I hope you'll resolve this for us.

lines.speaker: 휴고
lines.text: You don't need to make a separate report to me. That is all.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I suppose it can't be helped. Please look after Iris.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Wow! It's been ages, %s!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Good to see you again, Parmila.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: What have you been doing? I haven't seen hide nor hair of you! Hunting down a goddess or something?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hunting a goddess...? Hmm. I did fight something similar in a rather strange place.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Wow, so you did! Anyway, I had no idea the person coming from Lumen would be you, %s. That makes this an even nicer surprise!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Haha. Things just worked out that way.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: We wanted to investigate too, but the company already had jobs in progress, so we couldn't.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Then some people from the Alliance of Light on the eastern continent came and asked whether we'd seen anything unusual.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I told them what was happening here, and they said that matched what they were looking for.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Since the phenomenon was caused by Iris's unstable condition, they probably couldn't do anything about it immediately...)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Oh, %s. You're here. More to the point, Captain, how many missing-cat requests do we have?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: The people of Drulridge would be much better at finding animals...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: There are six cats left. I'm counting on you, Cal-lone.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Still six left...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Callone leaves with a look of utter spiritual defeat.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Finding runaway cats seems to be your main line of work.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Hehehe. You know us. We're a mercenary company—anything that pays!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shall we get to the point now?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Ahahaha, sorry. Let me tell you about the mountain. Beyond Jade Forest, there's a sinister-looking mountain that seems to be crawling with monsters.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: People call it 'Monster Tree Mountain,' and hardly anyone goes there. It's nearby, but the terrain is so rough that even our company hasn't visited.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: But lately, we've started hearing strange sounds. A monster's cry—neither human nor animal.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: The animals in the mountains and forest panicked and came down this way. It caused a huge commotion. The people of Drulridge calmed them and took them away, but...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: See the graveyard behind us? The people of Drulridge told us to be careful because they could sense the presence of the dead. We're looking into it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That sounds serious.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Everyone in Mirgandia is frightened. We're conducting our own investigation, so could you visit Monster Tree Mountain?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I've also heard there's an enormous, oddly shaped boulder there... You might as well check that out too. This sort of thing seems right up your alley.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll head there now.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Take care, then.

steps.name: Chaos at the Foothills
steps.objective: Defeat [Mountain Ogre Gardeners] and [Boar Warriors] at the entrance to "Monster Tree Mountain", then report to [Lapidem].

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Well, I'll be! You startled me!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Wait. What did I just hear?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaaah! The boulder's talking!

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Shh! Keep it down. You'll set that thing howling again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Y-yes...? I've never seen a talking boulder before.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I'm a spirit, you know. Name's Lapidem. And who might you be?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You explain to Lapidem what brought you here.)

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: So you're doing work for the new goddess? And you've come to look into the thing doing all that shouting?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right, Lapidem. I came because I heard there's a monster screaming inside Monster Tree Mountain.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Hmm. You're certainly no ordinary sort. I ought to have noticed you coming this far, but I didn't sense a thing.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Still, I see humans are calling this place 'monstrous' even now.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Truth be told, it isn't an ordinary place. Goddess Gaia gave it a little extra attention, so it's different from elsewhere, that's all.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Some things here might look frightening or ugly to human eyes. But that doesn't make them bad. It's no crime, is it?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Right? It's no crime in your case either.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, it's no crime for me either... Wait, what?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Say, would you do me a favor?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Sorry to ask when we've just met. With a body like this, I can't knock sense into the little ones who've gone mad. Could you deal with the ones causing trouble nearby?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I reckon Arborum's made them lose their minds a bit. Just bring them back to their senses, all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll give them a little talking-to.

steps.name: The Spirit's Trust
steps.objective: Talk to [Harmonia] in "Old Belos", then report to [Mir] in the "Burning City".

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: The little ones have come to their senses. Good work.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's nothing. It was something I could do.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I've been wondering how to handle that Arborum. Back when I served the goddess, I could've sorted it out without breaking a sweat.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you mean when you fought the Demon King?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: That's right. Gods perished in the fighting and fell onto Eastland. When I landed here, I nearly died myself.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Goddess Gaia joined me to a sacred boulder. That's how I survived instead of fading away.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I still remember her apologizing, plain as day. Come to think of it, it's about time she woke up...

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Will she go straight to the Land of Illusions when she wakes, I wonder...?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Ah, being a lump of rock is stifling. Can't go anywhere. Still, I've watched over this mountain for a long time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Um... Could you tell me what's happening on Monster Tree Mountain now, rather than what happened ages ago?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Sorry. It's hard to talk about, since it's my fault things ended up like this. Besides, we haven't enough 'trust' between us yet...

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: So I'd like you to show me something to build up that trust a little more.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Should I bring you something tasty? Or is there another job I need to do?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I don't eat food... Ah, I know. Get a Mark of Trust from the spirits who know you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A Mark of Trust?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I don't know about young spirits these days, but old ones like me need something that shows 'trust.' Evidence, you might say...

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: The goddess made us this way, so there's no helping it. Sorry about that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Where should I go, then...? Back to the inner world, perhaps...

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Hello, adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Harmonia.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: What brings you to the inner world today?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, you see...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Harmonia about meeting Lapidem, the rock spirit on Monster Tree Mountain.)

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: So Lord Lapidem is facing a difficult situation. I trust you, adventurer, but I don't know whether the extent of my trust would meet his standards.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But you're the Spirit King of Harmony and Stability. What about Geis?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Geis is in much the same position as I am.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: But there is someone who would meet those standards. Someone both you and Lord Lapidem know well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't tell me... Mir?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Yes, exactly. That child should be able to help you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Come to think of it, I hear you've been giving Mir all sorts of nice things.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that. It's nothing much.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Thank you for being so kind to Mir. The child will be waiting for you, so please go ahead.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Adventurer!

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: What brings you to the inner world again? Or have you come to give me more jerky? Hehe...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll give you the jerky first, but then you have to listen to me. All right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Mir about Lapidem on Monster Tree Mountain.)

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Old Lapidem doesn't trust such a wonderful adventurer, who supplies me with all this jerky? That's ridiculous!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm starting to think I can't trust you, Mir...

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Hehe. Don't worry.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: (Mir rests a hand on %s's shoulder for a moment.)

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: That should do it. I'm a descendant of the great Pluton Dragon, so this is as easy as eating warm jerky.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why do you describe everything in terms of eating jerky?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Because it's delicious! If you find anything even tastier, bring it next time!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (So Mir was already pulling jerky out of a pocket and eating it.)

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: I've left the Mark of Trust. Go show it to old Lapidem. Then he'll acknowledge you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thanks, Mir. I'm curious—how did you meet Lapidem?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: When Goddess Gaia wakes, I receive her messages and deliver them. Come to think of it, it's about time she woke up...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A goddess who sleeps and wakes...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd like to meet her someday, if I have the chance. I'll be going, then. Thank you.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: It's nothing. Thanks for the jerky! Bring more next time!

steps.name: Time for a Cleanup
steps.objective: Defeat [Arborum] in the "Monster Tree Mountain Valley", then report to [Lapidem].

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: You're back?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm back!

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I could feel that little one's trust in you from the foot of the mountain. Never could tell whether the child was a dragon or a spirit. But tell me, how did you earn that trust? Ah, did you offer food?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Lots of jerky from Lumen...

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: That child started bringing me Goddess Gaia's messages a few years ago. Every visit, the mountain ran out of food.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Never seen anything like it in thousands of years... The Shukris and Mountain Ogres were beside themselves with no food left. You'd think there was a starving Priring in that belly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh... I see. Then, as promised, could you tell me what's really happening on this mountain?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll try to solve the problem. Iris's work is my work, too.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: All right. I officially recognize you as Goddess Iris's errand-runner. I'd be grateful for your help.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: It happened a little while ago. I hadn't slept in thousands of years, but all of a sudden, I nodded off.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Only for an instant. An instant! About as long as it takes an ant to move one step.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: In that instant, a strange energy drifted around the mountain, then came down just like that! Rocks, rotten branches, and bits of rubbish gathered together and turned into that thing.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I didn't know why it was called 'Arborum,' but the moment I heard its cry, I understood something clear as day.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: It was made from power that had seeped through a rift from another dimension. Not power from this place.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. That power... Could it be connected to Iris?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I don't know the details, but it means the creatures of the Demon Realm aren't the only ones after the goddess.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: The Agasura clan, the lords of the Demon Realm, and a being from another world. What I can tell you for certain is... Urgh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong? Lapidem!

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Urgh. That Arborum's howling again. It's so loud that even a rock like me can't stand it. And I think it's devoured the mountain's spiritual energy.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: But why are you perfectly fine? Hardly seems fair...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Forget about that and stay with me! I'll go deal with the monster.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I'll hold on until you get back. Make sure you beat that thing. I'm counting on you!

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Oh, and give the troublemakers along the way a telling-off too. All right?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Ahh. At last, it feels like the mountain's spiritual energy is returning...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm back. Arborum certainly wasn't an easy opponent.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Thank you. Feels like all that lingering weariness has vanished! I won't forget this!

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: But it's not all over. Arborum may be gone, but it's left plenty of trouble behind.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait... If there's more, where would it... Oh, the graveyard!

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: What graveyard? The one near the castle where all those foolish humans gather?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (By foolish humans, he must mean the mercenaries.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's probably the place. They said they thought the dead were waking there.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you thinking?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Nothing at all...

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Oh, right. There's something I haven't told you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: When you have some free time later on, would you come see me?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: There's something I want to say. It's nothing urgent, so take your time thinking about it.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: For now, go see what's happened to those foolish humans. Find out how things stand, and we'll talk.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll go take a look.

steps.name: Searching for a Solution (1)
steps.objective: Go to "Monster Tree Mountain" and talk to [Lapidem].

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: You're back, %s? Ugh...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: It's worse than I thought. I was relieved that the monster's cries had stopped, but now the dead have risen from the graveyard.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: A scream came from Monster Tree Mountain, and then the graves suddenly split open. Skeletal mages and knights climbed out!

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Mages and knights turned into undead monsters...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A monster that appeared out of nowhere, and ghosts awakened by its cries...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: We knock them down, and they just get back up. Over and over. What a mess.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: %s, we'll hold them back somehow. Please find a way to stop this. I'm counting on you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Lapidem must know something... right?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll hurry. Hang in there! All right?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Hehe, don't underestimate our company! Arcane, let's show them what we can do!

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: You got it, Captain! Body Slam!

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Captain... Arcane...

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Sigh... No choice. I don't like it, but I'll have to use those techniques...

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: How are things?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The dead have risen in the graveyard and are coming out.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Before this, even if they woke up, they wouldn't have left. The druids' prayers for the unjustly slain king, his knights, and his mages had formed a barrier.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A dead king and knights?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Several hundred years ago, King Letum of Belkia was practically a saint to his own people.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: But compared to the old Empire, the Kingdom of Silvaria, and the other powers, his was just a small, weak kingdom.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: So he decided to do something: conquer the Mirgandia region.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: The ancient gods once stayed there, you see. Mirgandia had more magic and resources than anywhere else. If Belkia took it, the kingdom could have prospered. But...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What happened, then?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: The druids had lived in Mirgandia for ages. They didn't welcome foreign kingdoms and knights. Their calling was to keep nature just as it was.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: So Belkia's army and the druids fought for a long time. In the end, the Belkians were the first to stop.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I reckon Letum realized it was wrong and turned back. But a fellow you might know—Nepandus—killed every last one of them.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Then he laid a curse on them and made them undead. That Nepan-whatever was a nasty piece of work. Thankfully, the druids prayed for their souls to find peace.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: But Arborum's shriek broke the barrier. What do you think those returned dead will do now? They'll try to kill everything they see.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've fought Nepandus before, when he came back as a lich. I defeated him.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Really? So that was you. Well done. I did wonder why that filthy presence suddenly appeared, then vanished.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This won't be easy either, will it?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Even the goddess's errand-runner will have trouble dealing with the dead.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: You've done well so far, but this will be different. So I'll help. I'll lend you my power!

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: This power helps dead creatures find rest. I've been doing that a long time. If those fellows came before me, I'd lay the lot of them to rest...

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Oops, there I go rambling again. Now close your eyes. Don't open them halfway through, all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, I will.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (As you close your eyes, the spiritual energy of Monster Tree Mountain fills your body. You feel lighter, as though you hold all the world's nature within you.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This power...

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: It's only temporary, but it should help you return them to the earth. What are you waiting for? Get moving!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh! I'll go right now!

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Yes, yes. Good luck!

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: (A woman's faint image suddenly appears before Lapidem.)

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Oh? Could that be Goddess Iris?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It's a pleasure to meet you, Lapidem. And thank you for your help.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Not at all, Your Grace. It's my duty. Ah, there's something I didn't tell your errand-runner. Is that all right? About the 'sinner,' I mean.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I didn't think it was my place to speak about that.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes, you did the right thing. I don't think they should know yet. I'm still trying to understand it myself.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: If that's your wish, Goddess, I'll keep my mouth shut tight as a rock.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank you. I hope next time we can meet under better—

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: (Iris's image freezes in the middle of her sentence.)

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: (Still frozen, Iris's image disappears from Lapidem's sight.)

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Seems the goddess hasn't quite got the hang of it yet. Well, I'll keep quiet since she asked, but something about it doesn't sit right...

steps.name: The King Who Returned from Death
steps.objective: Defeat [Letum] in the "Warriors' Rest", then report to [Parmila] at the "Oscuras Temporary Camp".

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: My Body Slam isn't working... These things really are something.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Arcane, Quick Attack!

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Captain, he doesn't have a skill like that!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How are things, Callone?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Oh, you're back. Exhausting, frankly. Those two are certainly skilled, but sometimes their foolishness makes me want to scream.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I think I get the picture.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Whew... There are too many. How many Belkian soldiers were here, anyway...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Parmila, I'll handle it.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: You found a way? Really? A way to deal with the dead properly?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You explain that the spirit on Monster Tree Mountain has helped you.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: You really are amazing. Working for a goddess, getting help from spirits...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: What are you standing around for? Hurry up and deal with them! Fighting dead people isn't exactly pleasant!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'm going. While I'm inside, if any of them escape this way, force them back in as best you can. Understood?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Got it. Leave it to me.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: (Parmila watches %s intently as they enter the Warriors' Rest.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Hey, Callone.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Captain. You look like you have something to say.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: About %s... Do you think the Imperial Magic Research Institute has information on %s, too?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: They should have records on every famous or unusual individual.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Then isn't that dangerous?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: %s... Empress Kaina is watching over this person. Those impious people won't be able to lay a hand on them easily.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Worry about that later. For now, we should focus on the task at hand.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: For once, Callone says something I like. Hehe. Shall we get going?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I wasn't saying it to please you... Heh.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Captain. Captain, are you listening to me?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: The knights aren't moving anymore... That means...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Parmila, I'm back.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Just as I'd expect from %s... You took care of everything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. It wasn't easy. That's the third strange phenomenon dealt with...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Wait. These strange phenomena—are they going to keep happening?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They probably will for a while, won't they?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Does it have something to do with that person you were searching for all that time?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...It is connected to Iris, but it isn't her fault. It's hard to explain exactly. Please just understand that much.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Hehe. All right. You seem likely to keep sorting things out, so I won't worry.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Just don't start stealing our company's jobs too. Got it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry. I doubt our work will overlap.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Now, what else did we have to do...?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: We need a thorough survey of the Mirgandia region. No one knows what might happen next, or how.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Ugh, I don't care. I'm tired. I want a break.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Captain! Are you listening to me?!

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I'm kidding. Kidding! First, let's pray for those Belkian soldiers to rest in peace. We'll need to call in the druids for that, right?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Oh, %s... Tell that spirit I said thank you. I'd like to go myself, but it feels as though I'd be intruding on their territory. I'm sorry. And thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's nothing. I'm just glad it ended well.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Oh, I just remembered something I'd like your help with. It's not urgent. Come see me when you have time, and I'll tell you about it.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: No pressure. (Grins.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ... (Pretends not to notice.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be going, then. See you later, Parmila.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Take care. Whew... Now I can rest a little.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I was going to say goodbye, but they're gone already.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Callone, about that...

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Yes, Captain? Go ahead.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: We're short on money. Why don't you go find those cats first?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Ugh, all right. But Captain, I'm fairly sure a payment came in from the Empire a few days ago...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Ahahahahaha! No idea. I don't know anything. Let's just find the cats first. Ahahahahaha! Can't hear you!

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Captain! Captain, are you listening to me? Sigh...

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Well? All done?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The power you gave me seems to have vanished the moment I defeated King Letum.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Good work. If that's how it went, then all's well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. I'd better get going now. I still have things left to do...

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Of course, of course. Come visit now and then. There's plenty of good food here. Drop by when you feel like it and eat your fill, all right?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: You won't eat as much as that little one, will you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I couldn't possibly. I'll come help from time to time, so tell me some stories about the old days.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Agreed. Travel safely, then. I can't move this body, so I won't be seeing you out.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: By the way... Have you ever lost your memory? That's the sort of look you have.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? No. Everyone I've met lately keeps asking me that.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I may be able to help you. If you're interested, would you hear me out sometime?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I'm not forcing you. Just drop by when you have a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Lapidem.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't doze off like you did this time. Take care, all right? I'll be back.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Off you go, then. Hoho.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: (%s disappears from Lapidem's sight.)

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: That sinister smell is definitely an Agasura... So strong. A vicious one, by the scent of it.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Why don't you come out now, Jeril?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: (When Lapidem calls his name, a youthful-looking boy walks slowly toward him.)

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: As foul a beast as ever.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: It's been a while, old man. But I'm not the foul one. Your temper is.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I don't want you calling me old man. You're getting on in years yourself... What wickedness brings you here after hundreds of years, anyway?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Old man, don't you know me better than that?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I know you're different from those half-baked Agasuras.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Hehe. There's something I want to check. What's this 'sinner' you were discussing with the goddess? I came to ask about something else, but...

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: How much did you hear? And what did you want to ask?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Would 'another world' ring a bell?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: ...Wait. Another world? 'A▒▒el'?!

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: So you do know something. I was only testing the waters, but that really rattled you. Hehe. An unexpected find.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I don't know. Best leave it alone. I don't know much about it myself.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: A spirit holding all the world's wisdom, not knowing something? Never mind. Your reaction was enough. Now I'll just wait.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Still, what should I do with you, old man? I can't kill a spirit whose life a god saved...

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: What? What are you planning to do?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: I'll give you a present. A little dream that will soon make you forget I was ever here.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: (As Jeril smiles, Lapidem stops moving as though dead.)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Thanks to you, old man, I even learned that the sinner is connected to 'A▒▒el.' I'm quite satisfied.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: This was fun, old man. Take care.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: (Wearing a faint smile, Jeril disappears.)

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: (Only after a long while does Lapidem regain consciousness.)

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I feel strange... Did someone come by? Did I fall asleep again? Doesn't seem like it...

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Bah, I don't know. Shall I call the little ones and see how they're doing?
